$Comment: One of the Great Turkey's later phases, as it starts: its fight's Phase2Behavior and Phase3Behavior
slots both run this, each forwarded its own settings (Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Encounter.json).
The first moment the phase sees the Great Turkey bound in the Boss slot, it raises its flag
(ArmedFlag, so all of this happens once per try), puts Effect on it (none when Effect is empty),
raises AddCount of AddRole around the fight's entity, moves the music to MusicPhase and shows every
member Moment. Nothing else runs while the phase lasts: the Great Turkey keeps fighting as its role
fights, and the fight waves keep rising as its health falls. Give each phase its own ArmedFlag and
clear both in Macro_Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Reset, so the next try plays them again.

ArmedFlag.Description: The flag that marks this phase's start as played, so it plays once per try.

Effect.Description: The effect put on the Great Turkey for the rest of the fight. Empty puts none.

AddRole.Description: The creature that rises as the phase starts.

AddCount.Description: How many of AddRole rise, as a [min, max] range.

MusicPhase.Description: The music's phase as this phase starts: Phase2 or Phase3.

Moment.Description: The FeedbackMoment every member is shown as the phase starts. Empty shows nothing.

Range.Description: How far from the script's entity the Great Turkey is looked for.

Instructions.$Comment: As the phase starts: the effect, the adds, the music and the news, once.
